stem:
Yamini must solve $5x + 9 = 29$ by isolating $x$. The two sides are already equal.

Which first move preserves equality and removes the unwanted $+9$?

options.text: The first move is the label "inverse operations".
Subtract $9$ from the left side only, writing $5x = 29$.
Take $x = 29$, because $29$ is the largest printed number.

teacher.key_rationale: Equality is preserved only when the same inverse move hits both sides: subtract 9 from both to get 5x=20. Naming the phrase, changing one side only, or grabbing 29 miss that move.
